status_reason: Documentation oracle (Rhino 5 p33-35, highest authority) is implemented and measured: Shift adds, Ctrl toggles, plain click replaces, locked/hidden never enter the selection. Matrix9 decompiled references confirm the replace-or-add facade. QymCAD is reference-only.
authority_note: User direction 2026-10-19: Matrix9/Rhino5 documentation is the highest authority, then the decompiled Matrix9 reference, and QymCAD is only a Rust reference to consult and change when it does not fit. The QymCAD pin is therefore NOT a completion gate for this L4.

documentation_oracle.source: ref/rhino5 (Rhino 5 User Guide) p33-34, text rhino5__p33-34__selecting-objects.md
documentation_oracle.rule: Click selects one object; "Hold the Shift key while clicking the objects" adds; "Hold the Ctrl key and click the objects again" removes; "Click away from the objects or press the Esc key" cancels.
documentation_oracle.om9_behaviour: ui.rs click branch: plain -> select_root(replace), Shift -> select_root(add), Ctrl -> toggle_selection, empty -> clear, Esc -> clear_selection

documentation_oracle.rule: Window (left to right) takes only objects completely enclosed; crossing (right to left) also takes objects the window crosses; Shift adds and Ctrl removes with window/crossing.
documentation_oracle.om9_behaviour: ui.rs objects_in_band(window) + add_objects/remove_objects; clipped objects are excluded from window
